subject: Supplemental RTO/RPO artifacts + live witness scheduling
messages:
From: Sara Bryant <sara.bryant@novabank.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: procurements@novabank.com
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 20:03:00 -0400
Subject: RTO/RPO supplemental items and witness availability

Rachel —

Thanks for the tabletop last week. Our compliance team reviewed the materials and has two follow-ups before we close the BCP section of the SIG: a) timestamped evidence of a warm-cache restore and KV pre-warm timeline during the March 28th run, and b) a short live witness (30 minutes) where your ops engineer walks our auditors through the failover timeline and confirms the observed RTO/RPO numbers.

We uploaded a checklist to our portal (attached) with a few clarifications. High-level asks:
- A time-ordered log extract showing cache warm start -> connections restored -> first successful token served (UTC timestamps)
- Any synthetic run results you ran against that patch cycle (config parameters)
- Proposed 30-minute windows next week for the live witness (we're flexible mornings ET)

Can you confirm what artifacts you can provide and whether we can book a witness session on Monday or Tuesday?

Appreciate it — this is the final item for the audit return.

Sara Bryant
Senior IT Risk Manager
NovaBank

Attachments: Nova-requested-evidence-checklist.pdf (1 page)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Sara Bryant <sara.bryant@novabank.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RTO/RPO supplemental items and witness availability

Sara —

Thanks for the clear checklist and the heads-up. We can provide the time-ordered artifacts from the March 28th maintenance run and host a 30-minute live witness.

Plan / deliverables:  
- redwood-kv-warmcache-20270328-logs.txt — contains UTC timestamps for cache warm, connection handoff, and first token served (we've redacted PII/IDs per contract).
- rto-synthetic-runbook.md — run parameters and commands used in the synthetic verification (attached).
- A 30-minute live witness with our Senior Site Reliability Engineer (Neha) to walk your auditors through the timeline and answer questions.

Proposed slots (ET): Monday 2027-04-05 10:00–10:30 or Tuesday 2027-04-06 11:00–11:30. Please confirm which works for NovaBank. We'll share a live recording and the short Q&A log afterwards.

Internal notes / asks for the ops team: Marcus — please package the log slice with the timestamp index and ensure timestamps are converted to full ISO UTC. Neha — be ready to share the runbook and join the witness. Vanessa — leader for the compliance handoff + final attest.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Director, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-kv-warmcache-20270328-logs.txt; rto-synthetic-runbook.md

Rachel / team / Sara —

Attached is the log slice and a short explanation of events — timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC. Key points from the March 28th synthetic failover:
- 2027-03-28T14:02:11Z — cache pre-warm initiated (script start)
- 2027-03-28T14:03:42Z — KV layers online (connections accepted)
- 2027-03-28T14:03:58Z — first token returned to synthetic client (service ready)
- Observed RTO (measured from failover trigger to first token): 1m47s; RPO: <30s (consistent with our incremental snapshot policy)

I've redacted session IDs in the attached log extract. Marcus — I've left a note to include the command flags in the runbook for auditor review.

If those numbers look right to NovaBank, we're good to schedule the witness. Neha (SRE) will lead the walkthrough and can answer questions about caching strategy and restore gating.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Site Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference
